items.title: Lesson pack: src/auto/prep_lesson.py <queue id> writes .cache/pack/<id>/ with the lesson's transcript (as in Drive/wifaq-data, byte-exact), the OCR pages its passage covers (start/end found with rapidfuzz, one page either side, page labels kept), the previous lesson's last card, the next lesson's start, and this lesson's teacher flags from h4_exam.json. Drafting and QA agents read the pack instead of searching Drive.
items.done_when: tested on two already-carded lessons (e.g. 08-30 and 08-31): every card's v7 page lies inside the pack's OCR span and the transcript matches the source byte for byte; BRIEF.md and AUTOMATION section 5 point the agents to the pack; HANDOVER section 5 updated
items.why: cuts the usage of each drafting/QA agent (no Drive searching, no reading OCR files outside the passage) without changing what they check

items.title: src/qa/mech_check.py <card file>: everything QA can check by code. Timestamps exist (reuse check_a.py), S tags found in the OCR footnotes/interlinear of the cited or neighbouring pages (rapidfuzz on the sharh name), K7 pages inside the lesson's span, no card start overlapping the previous/next lesson's cards, each teacher flag of the lesson lands on a card. Prints a short report for the Opus QA agent.
items.done_when: run on all Karahiya card files: no false alarms on lines QA already passed, and it catches a planted wrong timestamp, a planted wrong S tag and a planted overlap; AUTOMATION section 5 step 3 uses it
items.why: the Opus QA agent then spends its effort only on rulings, attributions and ikhtilaf

setup_steps_for_user: On your Ubuntu: sudo -v ; curl https://rclone.org/install.sh | sudo bash

GitHub → repo wifaq-cards → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret: RCLONE_CONF = what you copied; GEMINI_API_KEY = your AI Studio key; VERTEX_API_KEY = your Vertex express key
Tell the panel 'secrets added' (a note). From then on, stop running Colab; the GitHub pipeline runs every day at 1:20 pm.
